import sys,json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import numpy as np
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'MonteCarloMarginalizeCode/Code'))
from RIFT.likelihood import factored_likelihood as fl
from RIFT.calmarg import rift_source
assert str(rift_source.__file__).startswith(str(root))
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/rossma/RIFT_roboto_paper/analyses/bilby_v_rift_likelihood')
import bilby_rift_asimov_noloop as b
import bilby
base=json.loads(Path('/Users/rossma/RIFT_roboto_paper/analyses/rift_backend_likelihood_internal_20261014/comparison.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for ra,dec in [(1.2,.3),(base['samples'][0]['ra'],base['samples'][0]['dec']),(base['samples'][58]['ra'],base['samples'][58]['dec'])]:
    cfg=dict(base['configuration']);cfg.update(ra=ra,dec=dec,time_interp='cubic',q_pregrid_factor=8)
    args=SimpleNamespace(**cfg);p=b.choose_waveform_params(args);pars=b.bilby_parameters(args)
    cp=dict(pars,spin_1x=p.s1x,spin_1y=p.s1y,spin_1z=p.s1z,spin_2x=p.s2x,spin_2y=p.s2y,spin_2z=p.s2z,iota=p.incl)
    wg=bilby.gw.WaveformGenerator(duration=args.duration,sampling_frequency=args.sample_rate,
        frequency_domain_source_model=rift_source.RIFT_lal_binary_black_hole,parameter_conversion=lambda x:(x,[]),
        waveform_arguments=dict(waveform_approximant=args.approximant,reference_frequency=args.analysis_fmin,minimum_frequency=args.template_fmin,maximum_frequency=args.fmax,sampling_frequency=args.sample_rate,Lmax=args.lmax,h_method='gws_hlmoft',extra_waveform_kwargs=args.waveform_extra_kwargs))
    ifos=bilby.gw.detector.InterferometerList([]);data={};psds={}
    for det in ['H1','L1']:
        psds[det]=b.psd_for_rift(getattr(args,det.lower()+'_psd'),det,1/args.duration,args.sample_rate/2,args.analysis_fmin)
        ifo=bilby.gw.detector.get_empty_interferometer(det);ifo.minimum_frequency=args.analysis_fmin;ifo.maximum_frequency=args.fmax
        ifo.set_strain_data_from_zero_noise(sampling_frequency=args.sample_rate,duration=args.duration,start_time=args.start_time)
        ifo.power_spectral_density=b.psd_for_bilby(psds[det],ifo.frequency_array)
        ifo.inject_signal(cp,waveform_generator=wg,raise_error=True);ifos.append(ifo)
        data[det]=b.lal_complex_fd_from_bilby_time_series(args,det,ifo.time_domain_strain)
    like=bilby.gw.likelihood.GravitationalWaveTransient(ifos,wg,time_marginalization=False,distance_marginalization=False,phase_marginalization=False)
    like.parameters.update(cp);lr=float(like.log_likelihood_ratio())
    noloop=b.rift_noloop(args,data,psds)['lnLambda_fixed_time'];delta=lr-noloop
    assert abs(delta)<3e-5,(ra,dec,delta)
    rows.append(dict(ra=ra,dec=dec,bilby_rift_adapter=lr,noloop_refined8=noloop,delta_nat=delta))
    print(rows[-1],flush=True)
result=dict(base_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),adapter_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(rift_source.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),scope='Fixed-time common RIFT-source injection, unchanged NoLoop, no empirical phase/time corrections; 4096 Hz, 1792-Hz cutoff, antisymmetric modes enabled.',rows=rows)
Path('/private/tmp/rift-taper-fix-likelihood.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
